core.gap.incomplete: Resource acquisition was incomplete. Resolve inventory errors and rescan before code generation.
core.gap.unsupported: Resource type is not covered by the provided CloudFormation schemas.
core.gap.managed: Resource is already managed by CloudFormation and is excluded by default.
core.gap.requiredWriteOnly: Property is write-only in the CloudFormation schema and must be supplied manually.
core.gap.requiredMissing: Required CloudFormation property is missing from inventory.
core.gap.createOnly: Property is create-only and may require replacement or import review.
report.structure.placementNotice: Stacks follow observed account, region and VPC ownership. AZs describe placement, not a mandatory stack boundary. Regional S3 and global IAM are not VPC children.
report.structure.noPlan: Generation-plan evidence is unavailable in this input. Service counts are not a stack plan.
report.structure.connectionNotice: Direction: the source depends on the target. Only detected configuration references are shown, not verified network reachability. Existing references do not create or import their targets.
report.structure.noConnections: No detected connections. This does not prove that resources are independent.
report.structure.graphOnly: Scope evidence only; no generated connection is verified. Check the source status and excluded properties.
report.structure.boundaryOnly: Boundary recorded; no generated reference is verified. Check manual/excluded resources.
report.structure.noScope: Scope provenance is unavailable. Selection reasons, full connection evidence and placement cannot be reconstructed from this legacy model.
report.structure.coverageNotice: Coverage counts only selected, acquired resources and known properties, not the entire AWS environment or deployment fidelity. Uncollected services, runtime traffic and S3 object data are outside this report. Unknown evidence still needs review even when coverage is 100%.
report.reason.empty-scope: No codeable resources in this scope.
report.reason.legacy-model-without-scope: Legacy model has no scope provenance.
report.reason.reference-property-not-in-: Reference property was excluded or changed during normalization.
report.reason.target-not-codeable: Target is not codeable; preserve or model it manually.
report.reason.target-attribute-unverifie: Target Ref/GetAtt attribute is not verified.
report.reason.resource-cycle-needs-revie: Resource cycle: a parameter retains the observed identifier; review before reuse.
report.reason.stack-cycle-needs-review: Stack cycle: a parameter retains the observed identifier; review before reuse.
report.reason.cross-environment-existing: Different or unknown environments: the existing identifier is retained; no cross-environment export is assumed.
report.reason.ambiguous-reference: Multiple possible targets; no target was guessed.
report.reason.unresolved-target: Target was not resolved from the inventory; the existing value is retained.
report.reason.literal-reference-no-impor: No verified CDK import helper; the existing value is retained for review.
report.import.commands: Follow the generated project README for language-specific setup, then IMPORT.md and stacks/<name>/IMPORT.md for the correct stack and mapping. Review and approve one stack at a time; this report never runs commands.
core.generate.importSetup: Complete the language-specific setup in the generated README first (including an isolated Python environment for Python projects).
core.scope.duplicate: Inventory contains duplicate resource keys. Separate accounts or remove duplicate observations before selecting resources.
core.gap.optionalWriteOnly: This optional property cannot be retrieved through CloudFormation. Supply it only if the feature is needed; this finding does not assert that it is missing from the live configuration.
cli.scope.options.region: --region <region>             Filter selection roots by region (repeatable); retain global resources and explicit dependencies.
core.scope.ambiguous: The selection matches multiple resources. Narrow the inventory by region or resource type before selecting an identifier.
core.gap.ec2Mapped: EC2 observation was translated into its CloudFormation property representation.
core.gap.ec2Split: Connection was extracted as a separate CloudFormation resource. Review its scope membership and import support.
core.gap.ec2Managed: AWS-managed or implicit connection is not authored as an independent resource.
core.gap.unmapped: Acquired property is not represented by the supplied CloudFormation schema. Review the inventory and model it manually; its value is not included in this finding.
core.gap.excluded: Read-only or explicitly excluded property is intentionally omitted from generated inputs.
cli.title: cdk-excavator (cdkx)
cli.description: Read AWS environments without write APIs and generate a review-ready AWS CDK draft.
cli.usage.title: Usage:
cli.usage.normalize: cdkx normalize --inventory inventory.json --scope scope.json [--schemas schemas/] [--gap-rules gap-rules/] [--model-output model.json] [--gaps-output gaps.json]
cli.usage.generate: cdkx generate --model model.json --gaps gaps.json [--outdir cdkx.out] [--stack-name ExcavatedStack] [--language typescript|python] [--lift-l2]
cli.commands.title: Commands:
cli.commands.scan: scan       Run a read-only AWS scan and write inventory.
cli.commands.scope: scope      Create a scoped resource document from inventory.
cli.commands.normalize: normalize  Create normalized model and gap documents from inventory and scope.
cli.commands.plan: plan       Preview a model/gap summary before code generation.
cli.commands.generate: generate   Create a review-ready TypeScript CDK project from model and gaps.
cli.commands.doctor: doctor     Run local preflight checks without AWS API calls.
cli.commands.iamPolicy: iam-policy Print the read-only IAM policy required by cdkx.
cli.commands.interactive: interactive Run an offline scope wizard from inventory.
cli.options.title: Options:
cli.scan.options.verbose: --verbose               Stream structured scan progress/API identifiers to stderr, never property values.
cli.normalize.options.gapRulesLocal: --gap-rules-local <path> Overlay local JSON rules on bundled or --gap-rules rules. Explicit opt-in only.
cli.options.query: --query <expression>    JMESPath query over the JSON summary; does not change output files.
cli.error.query: Invalid --query or --format, or unsupported command. Use a valid JMESPath expression on a non-interactive command. Query evaluation failures do not remove already written output files.
cli.options.lang: --lang <lang>  Output language: en or ja. Defaults to CDKX_LANG, OS locale, then en.
cli.options.resourceType: --resource-type <type>  Include only this CloudFormation resource type. Repeatable.
cli.options.excludeResourceType: --exclude-resource-type <type> Exclude this CloudFormation resource type. Repeatable.
cli.scan.title: cdkx scan
cli.scan.description: Run the read-only scan entrypoint. Use --fixture for offline inventory output without AWS API calls.
cli.scan.options.region: --region <region>        AWS region. Repeatable; first region is the discovery/global API endpoint.
cli.scan.options.allRegions: --all-regions            Scan all enabled regions (fixture: all recorded regions).
cli.scan.options.globalServices: --global-services <mode> include (default), exclude, or only. Global types are scanned once.
cli.scan.options.profile: --profile <profile>      AWS SDK profile name. Uses the standard AWS credential chain only.
cli.scan.options.output: --output <path>          Inventory output path. Defaults to inventory.json.
cli.scan.options.fixture: --fixture <path>         Offline inventory fixture path. No AWS API call is made.

cli.scope.title: cdkx scope
cli.scope.description: Create a scope document from an existing inventory file. No AWS API call is made.
cli.scope.options.mode: --mode <mode>           Scope mode. Currently supported: all, tag, vpc, seed.
cli.scope.options.tag: --tag <key=value>       Tag filter for tag mode. Repeatable.
cli.scope.options.tagOperator: --tag-operator <op>     Tag operator for tag mode: and | or. Defaults to and.
cli.scope.options.resourceId: --resource-id <id>      Required inventory resource identifier for seed mode.
cli.scope.options.depth: --depth <number>        Required non-negative outgoing dependency depth. Use 0 for seed only.

cli.scope.options.output: --output <path>         Scope output path. Defaults to scope.json.

cli.scope.wroteScope: Offline scope wrote scope document. inventory={inventory} mode={mode} output={output} resources={resourceCount} graphEdges={edgeCount}.
cli.normalize.title: cdkx normalize
cli.normalize.description: Create normalized model and gap documents from existing inventory and scope files. No AWS API call is made.

cli.normalize.options.modelOutput: --model-output <path>   Normalized model output path. Defaults to model.json.

report.title: cdk-excavator Gap and Import Report
report.reviewNotice: Generated review draft. Do not deploy or import resources until every gap, replacement risk, and mapping has been reviewed.
report.summary.title: Summary
report.gaps.title: Gaps by classification
report.gap.codeReference: Code reference: search generated source for TODO({code}).
report.gap.action.GAP-1: Model the resource manually or retain it as an external reference.
report.gap.action.GAP-2: Supply the value from an approved secret source before synthesis or import.
report.gap.action.GAP-3: Recover the value through an approved secure process; never place it in the report.
report.gap.action.GAP-4: Confirm whether AWS should continue managing the property and omit it when appropriate.
report.gap.action.GAP-5: Exclude the resource or coordinate with the owning CloudFormation stack.
report.gap.action.GAP-6: Move the resource to the correct region or model the global-resource behavior explicitly.
report.gap.action.GAP-7: Verify import support and replacement behavior with cdk diff before import.
report.import.title: Import instructions
report.import.step.review: Review every GAP and resource mapping; resolve blocked entries.
report.import.step.diff: Run synth and diff, then stop if unrelated changes or replacements appear.
report.import.step.retain: Confirm Retain policies for stateful resources.
report.import.step.execute: Run cdk import manually only after approval. cdk-excavator never executes it.
report.masking.title: Mask before sharing
report.masking.account: Account IDs, organization IDs, role names, and profile names.
report.masking.identifiers: ARNs, resource IDs, DNS names, bucket names, and other physical identifiers.
report.masking.properties: Tags, policies, routes, security rules, endpoints, and application-specific property values.
report.masking.files: Review inventory.json, model.json, gaps.json, cdk-import-review.json, generated code, and this report together.
report.references.title: Cross-references
report.references.todo: Generated code uses TODO(GAP-n) comments matching the classifications above.
report.references.gapsJson: gaps.json is the machine-readable source for every visible finding.
report.references.importReview: cdk-import-review.json is the source for import status, identifiers, and review reasons.
core.scan.listenerParentExcluded: Listener discovery requires listing load balancers, but that parent type is explicitly excluded. Remove the LoadBalancer exclusion or exclude Listener as well.
core.generate.description: Generated by cdk-excavator. Review gaps and import mapping before cdk import.
core.generate.jsonKey: CDK cannot preserve the __proto__ JSON key. Review the input; generation was stopped without dropping that property.
core.generate.stackName: Stack name must start with a letter and contain at most 128 letters, digits or hyphens.
core.generate.pythonSetup: Create and activate an isolated Python 3.10+ virtual environment before running the commands below.
core.generate.importCwd: Run these commands from the generated project root, not this guide's subdirectory. Review and run one import at a time; the tool never executes it.
core.generate.aggregate: Review-only aggregate. Use the separately generated stack templates, never this aggregate for deployment.
core.generate.cycleParameter: Existing reference retained to break a dependency cycle. Review before import or reuse.
core.generate.boundaryParameter: External reference selected during scope review.
core.generate.quota: Generated stack exceeds a CloudFormation parameter or output quota. Narrow the scope and review its boundaries.
core.generate.references: Reference-preserving L1. Review stack-plan.json and boundary decisions before changing this resource.
core.generate.multiReadme: This project contains multiple stacks. Review stack-plan.json and each stacks/<name>/IMPORT.md. Run synth for all stacks, but diff/import one explicitly selected stack at a time. Unknown environments and existing cross-environment references require review.
